description: This file implements middleware functions for authentication in a Node.js/Express application, including extracting Bearer tokens, deriving user identities, loading user data from a database, and attaching user context to requests.

methods.name: getBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts Bearer token from request headers.

methods.name: deriveIdentityFromToken
methods.description: Derives user identity (id or email) from a simple token pattern.

methods.name: loadUserFromDb
methods.description: Loads a user document from the database based on derived identity or headers.

methods.name: attachAuthContext
methods.description: Middleware that attaches req.user with user info if a valid token is present.

methods.name: requireAuth
methods.description: Middleware that enforces authentication by checking req.user.
